name: Напад на зв’язану фігуру (2)
description:
A pin does not necessarily have to consist of two opposing pieces. It is also possible that a pinned piece cannot move because a checkmating square is attacked behind it. By attacking the pinned piece, material can then be gained. See example 1.

What do you have to do?

Look for a piece and a mating square on the same line. Found one? Then attack the opponent's pinned piece and win material.

examples.text:
The white rook pins the bishop. The bishop cannot leave, otherwise white gives a back rank mate.
By attacking the bishop with 1.g5! white gains material. If black leaves the bishop standing, white captures the bishop on the next move. If the bishop moves away, for example by capturing the white pawn, then black is mated: 1...Bxg5 2.Rf8#

Note also that 1...Be7 is met by 2.Rxe7.

texts: Pieces can be pinned to a square. Attack this piece again.
